title: Bootstrap the private repository and issue backlog
story: As Oz, I can collaborate through a repository with a traceable project backlog.
acceptance_criteria: Starter files are committed to the selected repository.
Prepared issues have stable FW IDs and dependency references.
Runtime secrets and operational records are excluded from source control.

title: Verify the local Docker launch on the target computer
story: As Oz, I can start the workbench and documentation with the launch guide.
acceptance_criteria: App health and documentation pages open on localhost.
The IT demo completes and exports a report.
Run history remains after an app restart.

title: Validate the work API project with synthetic notes
story: As Oz, I can select a model and obtain a source-backed draft through the work API project.
acceptance_criteria: The selected model supports the structured result contract.
A synthetic source completes within the configured call limit.
API usage is visible in the chosen project and credentials stay server-side.

title: Run repository CI and documentation checks
story: As a maintainer, I can verify code and documentation on every proposed change.
acceptance_criteria: Tests and the generated-role check pass in GitHub Actions.
The strict Sphinx build passes.
Built documentation is available as an Actions artifact.

title: Introduce structured operational task records
story: As Oz, I can inspect explicit actions with owners, dates, and supporting source excerpts.
acceptance_criteria: Task schema distinguishes explicit commitments, direct instructions, and inferred proposals.
Missing owners and dates remain unknown.
Action records link to evidence and acceptance criteria.

title: Add versioned evidence records and source locations
story: As a reviewer, I can trace each finding to the precise source and version.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence has stable IDs, source locators, timestamps, and text offsets or page references.
Source updates preserve prior versions used by completed runs.
Review results distinguish supported claims from uncertain interpretations.

title: Implement the approved priority-policy engine
story: As PM FRAN, I can explain priority using owner-approved rules and referenced facts.
acceptance_criteria: Rules and tie-breakers are versioned configuration.
Rule evaluation and arithmetic are deterministic and tested.
Each priority decision records policy version, facts, assumptions, and unresolved ties.

title: Support project check-ins and task reconciliation
story: As Oz, I can add instructions after a meeting without duplicating existing work.
acceptance_criteria: Check-ins attach to a project and existing task records.
Candidate duplicates are identified before creating new tasks.
Changes to scope, ownership, or deadlines retain their source and history.

title: Consolidate clarification questions without blocking unrelated work
story: As Oz, I receive a concise packet of questions with the work each answer unblocks.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated questions are merged.
Blocking and nonblocking gaps are distinguished.
Unrelated ready tasks continue while questions await an answer.

title: Load versioned workflows from configuration
story: As a developer, I can add a specialist through role and workflow configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency graphs are validated before use.
New role instances are registered by capability and project.
Inserted specialists retain separate review gates.

title: Add per-role runtime and model profiles
story: As an operator, I can select an appropriate runtime profile for each role.
acceptance_criteria: Profiles are separate from role instructions and business data.
Changing a provider does not change core task/result contracts.
Usage is attributable to a role and run.

title: Connect an approved Outlook or Teams source
story: As Oz, I can investigate selected work discussions without manually pasting each source.
acceptance_criteria: Choose and document one source, authentication path, and scoped access.
Incremental cursors and source IDs prevent duplicate ingestion.
A synthetic or authorized test source can be fetched and traced to its original location.

title: Add invoice and document ingestion
story: As an analyst, I can extract source-backed fields from contracts, invoices, and reference documents.
acceptance_criteria: Extraction preserves document/version/page references.
Totals, currencies, periods, and uncertain OCR fields are validated.
A small representative evaluation set has recorded expected results.

title: Add a read-only WellSky reporting adapter
story: As a WellSky analyst, I can prepare and execute permitted diagnostic reporting queries.
acceptance_criteria: Identify the exact accessible database and supported reporting route.
The connector enforces read-only credentials, query scope, row limits, and timeouts.
Results retain query text, parameters, evidence links, and execution metadata.

title: Connect one ticket or draft destination
story: As Oz, I can move accepted work into the chosen operational destination.
acceptance_criteria: Select the actual ticket system or email-draft destination.
Payloads are scoped, deduplicated, and linked to their task.
Execution returns an external ID and observed outcome.

title: Implement exact-action policy checks and scoped tool adapters
story: As the project owner, I can define which precise actions run automatically and which need a decision.
acceptance_criteria: Policies evaluate actor, project, action type, resource, and exact payload.
A changed payload is checked again.
Tools enforce permissions outside model prompts and record authorization and outcome.

title: Deliver the first IT provider assessment
story: As management, I can compare supported IT service options and their costs.
acceptance_criteria: Contracted scope and invoice spending are reconciled.
Comparable requirements, service levels, transition costs, and assumptions are visible.
The report includes evidence, alternatives, and concrete decisions required.

title: Deliver a forms or vendor-portal tablet pilot
story: As Oz, I receive a testable implementation with only the physical account/device test remaining.
acceptance_criteria: Current process and required form fields are documented.
Implementation passes agreed functional checks with synthetic data.
The handoff includes account connection, tablet steps, expected results, and failure capture.

title: Add durable scheduling and bounded rework
story: As Oz, I can run recurring work with recoverable state and bounded correction loops.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler and queue survive process restarts.
Retries and rework have limits, idempotency, and clear stop reasons.
Cancellation and interrupted-step reconciliation are tested.

title: Add usage accounting and enforceable run budgets
story: As an operator, I can understand and bound model spending.
acceptance_criteria: Input/output usage is recorded by role, step, and run.
Model-specific prices are versioned with their source/date.
Admission and reservation rules prevent new work beyond the configured budget.

title: Add authenticated remote and multiuser access
story: As an organization, we can share an approved installation with scoped access.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated users have explicit project membership.
Remote transport, access checks, and session handling are tested.
User actions and operational runs are attributable.

title: Add database migrations and tested backup restoration
story: As an operator, I can upgrade and restore saved work reliably.
acceptance_criteria: Schema migrations are versioned and tested on representative data.
Backup and restore procedures are exercised.
Retention settings cover source notes, artifacts, events, and backups.

title: Add documentation publishing and journal feeds
story: As a reader, I can navigate versioned guides, articles, FAQs, and project updates.
acceptance_criteria: Choose the documentation audience and hosting destination.
Version selection and blog/RSS behavior are documented.
Published pages pass navigation and content checks.

title: Evaluate executable packaging after the local pilot
story: As Oz, I can choose an installer or executable if it simplifies operating the application.
acceptance_criteria: Compare container, Python, and executable update/backup paths.
Document startup, credential storage, and platform support.
Package only after the selected path passes target-machine validation.
